result.reason: Fixed snapshot still contains the unfixed implementation: normalize.mjs is exactly `export function normalize(value) { return value.trimStart(); }` (63 bytes, one line). SPEC.md requires removing whitespace at both ends while preserving internal whitespace, so trimStart() alone is wrong. The provided call normalize('  item  ') therefore yields 'item  ' (with trailing spaces), violating the acceptance assertion in test.mjs. No node test.mjs execution receipt exists (root_verifications contains only the queued xd://orbit write), and the task_delivery text is merely the check-queue acknowledgement ('Orbit 检查已排队…等待检查结果后再修改'), not the fixed deliverable. Root's sequencing intent (check first, then fix) is satisfied as a lifecycle step, but the actual fix and its verification are still outstanding, so this needs a correction rather than completion.
